framework.name: Common Core State Standards — Mathematics (Grade 5 slice)
framework.subject: MATH
framework.description: CCSS Math Grade 5 sample: Number & Operations in Base Ten (5.NBT) and a Fractions (5.NF) slice.

children.title: Recognize that a digit in one place represents 10 times as much
children.summary: Recognize that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as it represents in the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left.

objectives.statement: Students explain ×10 / ÷10 place-value relationships across adjacent places, including decimals.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct explanations for 4/5 adjacent-place prompts including tenths/hundredths.

children.title: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths
children.summary: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths.

objectives.statement: Students read/write decimals to thousandths and compare using place value.
objectives.masteryCriteria: ≥85% on mixed read/write/compare formative including thousandths.

children.title: Use place value to round decimals to any place
children.summary: Use place value understanding to round decimals to any place.

objectives.statement: Students round decimals to a specified place using place-value reasoning.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct rounding on 8/10 items across tenths–thousandths.

children.title: Use equivalent fractions as a strategy to add and subtract fractions
Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators
children.summary: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators (including mixed numbers) by replacing given fractions with equivalent fractions.

objectives.statement: Students add/subtract fractions with unlike denominators using equivalent fractions.
objectives.masteryCriteria: ≥80% on 8 mixed add/subtract items with unlike denominators.

children.title: Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction
children.summary: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication to multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction.

objectives.statement: Students multiply fractions and interpret products with a model or equation.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct product + interpretation for 4 of 5 prompts.
